note: Read-only call-graph / entrypoint analysis. No branch switch, no reset. run_factory.py selected as canonical production orchestrator; run_episode.py kept as a test-covered alternative (its real Kokoro toolchain venv /tmp/kilo/z1_venv is missing, tests use fake stages). assemble_pilot_final.py remains the low-level FFmpeg renderer helper invoked by run_factory's render stage.

entrypoints.intended_role: Single public production orchestrator (canonical). 13 fail-closed, checkpointed, resumable stages: zero_cost_gate -> ... -> package_draft. Uses lib.zero_cost_gate + lib.checkpoint. Declares strict zero-cost routes.
Low-level FFmpeg assembly renderer helper (internal, not a public orchestrator). Builds per-bit zoompan clips, concat, burns subtitles -> MP4. Called by run_factory render stage.
Alternative episode pipeline (Milestone Z3). Same stage family as run_factory. Tested with fake stages; real Kokoro toolchain requires missing venv /tmp/kilo/z1_venv/bin/python.

decision: canonical = scripts/run_factory.py. run_episode.py is NOT converted to a wrapper in this change because that would risk its passing test suite; it remains a maintained alternative entrypoint sharing the same stage contract. assemble_pilot_final.py stays the internal FFmpeg renderer helper.
env_gaps: kokoro package and weights NOT installed -> voice stage BLOCKED (S4.3)
faster_whisper NOT installed -> ASR/WER gate BLOCKED (S4.3)
soundfile NOT installed -> kokoro_tts module and test_audio_production_engine fail to collect (pre-existing, not caused by this change)
